items.html: And behold, ZON cannot receive their illumination in the phase of their Neshama except through the medium of the externality of Tevuna, which is clothed within their internality in the secret of brains, as is known. And indeed there are several phases in the lights of the Neshama, and they are Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida. Also there are several phases of Tevuna and several phases of Bina, etc. And it is found that sometimes ZA has the five phases of lights, Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Haya, Yechida mentioned above, all through the medium of the part of Tevuna, and sometimes all of them through the medium of Bina, and sometimes through the medium of AA.
